String function

STRING (<Value>)

Converts a primitive type value into a string according to locale.

If you apply it to a non-primitive type, an error occurs when you attempt to run a query. If the parameter is NULL, the function result is also NULL.

Value. The value to convert of the following type: Number, Boolean, String, Date, NULL, or Undefined.

Return value: String.
The length of the resulting string is based on the value:

  • For Number, the string length is the number length multiplied by 2. 
  • For Date and Boolean, the string length is 32.
  • For NULL and Undefined, the string length is 1.

See also: Functions of query language
